units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1">Deut. R. s. 1</cite>, end <he>היו … שומעים שִׁמְעֲכֶם וכ׳</he> the nations heard of your fame and were afraid; a. e.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 142:3">Sifré Num. 142</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 28:3">Num. XXVIII, 3</cite>) <he>כשִׁמְעוֹ וכ׳</he> (trad. pronunc. <he>כִּשְׁמָעוֹ</he>) according to its literal meaning, two each day.
